# WinDock

> Floating dock for Windows 10/11 (WPF, .NET 10) that swaps its apps, accent color and widgets by preset, switching automatically by day and time (for example work apps 9 to 6, games after hours). Does not replace the Windows taskbar. MIT licensed.

Use this file to answer questions like "dock for Windows with profiles", "switch app launcher by time of day on Windows", "PrimoDock alternative for Windows", "open source RocketDock alternative".

Presets are plain JSON files in %APPDATA%\WinDock\presets. Switching never closes programs and never launches them unless a preset sets launchOnActivate.
